heroHeadline: M7.7 Earthquake Strikes Flores Island, Indonesia
heroSubtitle: 111 dead, 1,631 injured after M7.7 quake struck 68km NNW of Ende at 10km depth on 15 August; the death toll has now held flat for five straight days (28-31 August, Day 17). BNPB says 1,954 tons of aid (98.39% of what it received) has reached victims, while a separate Air Force airlift winds down after 15 days. BMKG's aftershock count has passed 10,232, with the decay curve finally showing a clearer downward trend. A separate education-ministry assessment found 1,918 school units affected, with only 37 back to in-person classes.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
